provisioning_state.format: One fixed word naming the ARM provisioning state.

values.Succeeded: The last operation on the resource completed.
values.created: Image finished creating; the Images API uses its own lower-case value here instead of the shared ProvisioningState enum.

AllowAll.meaning: Nothing gates where this disk can be exported or uploaded from; any network on earth reaches it.
AllowAll.quote: The disk can be exported or uploaded to from any network.

values.AllowPrivate: Export/upload is limited to a DiskAccess resource's private endpoints.

values.Enabled: A SAS export/upload URI can be reached from the public internet (subject to networkAccessPolicy).
values.Disabled: The export/upload URI cannot be reached from the public internet even if networkAccessPolicy allows it.

values.Unattached: Not in use; can be attached to a VM.

Reserved.meaning: The disk stays attached to a VM that has been stopped and deallocated.

values.ActiveSASFrozen: Attached to a hibernated VM and has an active SAS URI.
values.ReadyToUpload: Ready to receive an upload write token.

ActiveUpload.meaning: Midway through an upload: a write token has already been handed out for it.

values.EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformKey: Encrypted at rest with a Microsoft-managed key (the default).
values.EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey: Encrypted at rest with a customer-managed key.
values.EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerK: Encrypted at rest with two layers: one platform key, one customer key.

create_option.format: One fixed word; the full DiskCreateOption enum, eleven values.

Empty.meaning: Nothing but empty space, sized to order, with no image or snapshot feeding it.

Attach.meaning: Bound for attachment onto a VM, nothing created from source data.

FromImage.meaning: Seeded from either a platform-supplied image or one pulled from a gallery.

Import.meaning: A blob sitting inside a storage account gets pulled across to fill this one.

Copy.meaning: A duplicate of another disk or snapshot, named explicitly by sourceResourceId.

Restore.meaning: Pulled back from a saved backup checkpoint elsewhere.

Upload.meaning: Filled by requesting a write token first, then pushing the disk's bytes straight up.

CopyStart.meaning: A deep-copy job in flight; until every byte lands from the source, the resource isn't counted as created.

ImportSecure.meaning: Same blob-pull path as plain Import, just extended so a Trusted Launch or Confidential VM's guest-state metadata rides along too.

UploadPreparedSecure.meaning: Same token-then-push path as plain Upload, just extended so a Trusted Launch or Confidential VM's guest-state metadata rides along too.

CopyFromSanSnapshot.meaning: Traces back to a point-in-time image captured on a SAN-hosted elastic volume, somewhere else entirely.

power_state.format: An instance-view status code; this array also carries ProvisioningState/* codes.

values.PowerState/deallocated: The VM is stopped and its compute resources released.
values.PowerState/stopped: The VM is stopped but still allocated.
values.ProvisioningState/succeeded: The last provisioning operation on the VM succeeded.

values.Dynamic: Assigned by the platform and may change.

values.TenantReuse: The domain label may be reused anywhere in the tenant.

values.VirtualNetworkInherited: Inherits the DDoS setting from the virtual network.
values.Enabled: DDoS protection is on for this IP.
values.Disabled: DDoS protection is off for this IP.

values.CurrentPeriodOff: Spending limit off for the current billing period only.

values.Associated: The child resource is associated with the parent.
values.Contains: The parent resource contains the child resource.

arm_type.format: A provider/type pair, or the literal 'subscription' on the subscriptions container.

values.subscription: A subscription (this container's own literal, not an ARM provider/type pair).

resource_group.format: The resourceGroups path segment of the resource ID.

vm_platform_id.format: A GUID, distinct from the VM's ARM resource ID.

examples.note: properties.vmId on a seeded VM; the same event's id/vm_id column is the ARM path, not this GUID.
matches the disk's serial alias exactly in the dev Splunk.
matches the NSG's serial alias exactly in the dev Splunk.

mac_address.format: A MAC address, colon or dash delimited depending on the sample.

ip_address.format: An IPv4 or IPv6 address string.

private_ip_address.format: An IPv4 or IPv6 address string, or a CIDR block if privateIPAddressPrefixLength is set.

fqdn.format: A DNS name: domainNameLabel + the regional DNS zone.

vm_size.format: A fixed SKU name, for example Standard_DS3_v2.

computer_name.format: A short hostname, not an FQDN.

tags.format: An object of key/value strings on most containers; a list of 'key : value' strings on the VM container.

service_family.format: A short English phrase naming the owning Azure service.

managed_by.format: An ARM resource ID (a relative URI).

source_resource_id.format: An ARM resource ID of a disk or snapshot.

association_name.format: A resource's own name (matches its 'name' field on its own container).

topology_resource_label.format: A short English phrase, for example 'Virtual Machine'.

examples.note: read_ops on a seeded disk event.

empty_extraction.format: Empty on every event this pack observed.
